title: Band-9 Samples: When do you think you’ll next make a telephone call? [Why?]
passage_html:
This post contains ideas and band-9 sample answers (audio included) for the Cambridge IELTS 9 Academic Speaking Part 1 Question 3 Test 3 question:

“When do you think you’ll next make a telephone call? [Why?]”

Sample 1

I’ll probably make a telephone call immediately after this test. I have made it a habit to connect with my parents daily, and they’re eagerly waiting to hear about my IELTS experience.

Sample 2

I anticipate making a phone call perhaps later tonight. Each day, I make it a point to check in with my elderly parents. They live alone and I find that a simple call can lift their spirits and provide me with peace of mind.

Sample 3

I reckon my next telephone conversation will take place later this evening. You see, I’ve got a scheduled conference call with the overseas team regarding our upcoming project. It’s a sort of brainstorming session where we hash out our strategies and ideas.

Sample 4

I speculate I’ll be dialing a number on my phone later tonight. The reason is quite personal and romantic: I’m planning to escort my girlfriend to a just-opened restaurant this weekend. Being a hot spot, I need to confirm our reservation in advance to avoid being turned away at the door.

Sample 5: Not Sure

Honestly speaking, it’s quite unpredictable when my next telephone conversation will happen. Life is full of surprises, and we can’t always anticipate what’s around the corner. I might get a call from a friend out of the blue, or I might need to ring up a service provider. So, the exact time remains a mystery.

Sample 6: Not Sure

In this digital age, I primarily communicate through messaging apps and emails, reducing my need for traditional phone calls. Therefore, it’s challenging to predict when my next telephonic conversation will occur. It could be weeks from now or even tomorrow.

Sample 7: Not Sure

As someone who thrives on spontaneity, I seldom know when my next call will be. The unexpected nature of calls often adds an element of surprise to my daily routine. It could be a call to fix a sudden appointment or an unplanned catch-up with a friend. Hence, I can’t put a timestamp on my next call.

Sample 8: It Depends

I’m actually uncertain when my next telephone conversation will occur. It depends entirely on the need of the hour. For instance, if a work-related issue arises that necessitates immediate attention, I’ll make a call promptly. The unpredictability of life makes it difficult to pinpoint an exact time.

Sample 9: It Depends

I can’t really foresee my next telephone call because I rely mostly on digital communication tools like emails and instant messaging apps. I only resort to phone calls when there’s an urgent matter, so the timing is usually unpredictable.

Sample 10: It Depends

As someone with a vibrant social life, I honestly can’t predict when the next telephone interaction will occur. Friends could ring me up at any moment for a spontaneous meet-up or to share exciting news, so it’s really contingent upon the circumstances.
